name: tebra-mcp-server
description: Patients, scheduling, encounters, billing, and FHIR clinical data from your own Tebra (Kareo) account.
long_description: Connects an existing Tebra practice to Claude through the Tebra SOAP API v2.1 and FHIR R4 API. Independent open-source project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Tebra. All data stays between this extension, your Tebra account, and Claude; nothing is proxied through a third-party server. Tool results contain protected health information — use it only under a Claude plan covered by a Business Associate Agreement with Anthropic.

tebra_soap_user.title: Tebra SOAP API user
tebra_soap_user.description: API user email generated in Tebra PM under Settings > API.

tebra_customer_key.title: Tebra customer key
tebra_customer_key.description: Per-practice customer key from Tebra PM admin.

tebra_fhir_client_id.title: FHIR client ID (optional)
tebra_fhir_client_id.description: OAuth2 client ID from a Tebra appSphere Backend App. Enables the 13 FHIR clinical tools.

tebra_fhir_private_key_path.title: FHIR private key (optional)
tebra_fhir_private_key_path.description: PKCS#8 PEM private key for SMART Backend Services private_key_jwt. Its public half is the JWKS registered with Tebra. Read from disk once; never transmitted.

tebra_fhir_kid.title: FHIR key ID (optional)
tebra_fhir_kid.description: The kid of the private key in your published JWKS. Required whenever a key path is set.

tebra_fhir_client_secret.title: FHIR client secret (optional)
tebra_fhir_client_secret.description: Legacy client_secret fallback, used only when no private key path is set.
